corpus.description: Immutable public Vivary corpus revision. Accepted evidence paths are original public source paths under this SHA.

runtime_requirements.notes: Before trials, add manifest.runtime with the candidate model runtime version, runtime/package-source/wheel hashes, adopted-corpus tree hash, and settings hash. results.json must repeat that object byte-for-byte. Absence of both runtime and results is valid and complete for this protocol freeze.

design.support_rule: Each question requires 3/3 supported replicates on every arm. supported is derived by the validator from claims/evidence; caller-supplied verdicts are rejected.

prompt.template: Using only the frozen Vivary checkout, answer: {question}. Return JSON with claims [{claim_id, value, evidence [{path, line_hash}]}], unknowns, and a concise answer. Use only permitted tools; unsupported claims must be unknown.

baseline.description: Deterministic file listing/search and bounded reads only.

vivary.description: One tropo find --governed call, then reads of only capsule-selected evidence.

trial_row_schema.wrong_files_opened_definition: Integer count of opened paths outside that question's accepted evidence set; validator-derived and cross-checked.
trial_row_schema.timing_definition: Start immediately before first retrieval; stop after valid JSON is returned.
trial_row_schema.supported_definition: Required output field, but never trusted: scripts/check_context_benchmark.py derives support from claim IDs/values and evidence line hashes against questions.json, rejects unknown verdict fields, and fails when the supplied boolean disagrees.

statistics.cohort_separation: Summaries are emitted per arm and per question; arms are never pooled into one cohort.
statistics.publish_rule: Publish median and per-question input/output/total-token deltas, turns, wrong-file counts, and elapsed time even if Vivary loses. Make only the exact savings claim the data supports.

line_hash.input: exact source line bytes including the trailing newline when present in the frozen blob
